name: Accenture
title: 8-K · NEWS RELEASE OF ACCENTURE, DATED OCTOBER 1, 2026

read.thesis: Accenture beat Q4 FY26 revenue guide (+7% LC, above 1-5% range) and guided FY27 LC growth 3-6% with margin expansion, but supply-side signals are thin: capex stays low and buybacks are funded partly with debt.

triggers.label: Q4 revenue +7% LC above guide
triggers.quote: Revenues for the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026 were $18.68 billion, an increase of 6% in U.S. dollars and 7% in local currency, and were above the company’s guided range

triggers.label: FY27 LC growth 3-6% guided
triggers.quote: Company expects full-year revenue growth of 3% to 6% in local currency

triggers.label: DSO up to 50 days from 47
triggers.quote: Days services outstanding, or DSOs, were 50 days at August 31, 2026, compared with 47 days at August 31, 2025.

guidance.quote: Company expects full-year revenue growth of 3% to 6% in local currency
Expects full-year GAAP diluted EPS of $14.39 to $14.81, a 6% to 9% increase
Company expects to return at least $9.5 billion in cash to shareholders in fiscal year 2027

prior_guidance_check.quote: above the company’s guided range of $17.75 billion to $18.40 billion, or 1% to 5% growth in local currency
above the company’s guided range of 3% to 4% growth in local currency

red_flags.label: DSO rising 47 to 50 days
red_flags.quote: Days services outstanding, or DSOs, were 50 days at August 31, 2026, compared with 47 days at August 31, 2025.
